data.label: BUSINESS CHALLENGES
data.heading: Managing complexity in a fragmented environment
data.body:
Before implementing Prophix, InfrastructureX relied on a highly fragmented reporting process across eight countries and 47 legal entities. Each subsidiary operated with its own unique templates and timelines, forcing the finance team to manually consolidate data, reconcile currencies, and perform intercompany eliminations in Excel every quarter.

This manual approach became unsustainable as the company faced increasing scrutiny from PE sponsors and auditors. The status quo resulted in a 28-day close cycle, delayed board reporting, and a material financial restatement due to an undetected intercompany error, making a robust, auditable financial system a critical necessity for the business.

data.label: WHY PROPHIX
data.heading: What made Prophix the right fit
data.body:
- Ability to handle multi-currency consolidation across eight distinct jurisdictions.
- Capacity to manage project-entity accounting and model infrastructure project timelines.
- Requirement for a scalable system to support complex intercompany lending and eliminations.

data.label: KEY RESULTS
data.heading: Transforming finance from data entry to strategy
data.body:
The implementation of Prophix has fundamentally shifted the finance function from manual data management to strategic analysis. By automating the consolidation process, the team successfully reduced the quarterly close cycle by 68 percent, allowing board packs to be delivered on day eleven rather than four weeks after period end.

Beyond speed, the organization achieved a new level of data integrity and collaboration. The finance team now provides PE sponsors with direct, read-only access to reporting, fostering greater trust and transparency. Furthermore, the annual audit process has become significantly more efficient, as auditors can now easily trace all consolidation entries, eliminations, and currency revaluations.

Most notably, the automation of intercompany reconciliation—which previously took six to eight days—now occurs in under two hours. This efficiency gain allowed the CFO to reallocate three team members from repetitive data entry to high-value FP&A activities, such as scenario modeling and project profitability analysis.

data.title: OPERATIONAL TRANSFORMATION
data.quote: my people are doing real finance work now. Not data entry. Not reconciliation. Not chasing subsidiaries for their Excel files.

data.title: CLOSE CYCLE IMPROVEMENT
data.quote: We closed in nine working days. Nine. We had been at 28. That's a 68 percent reduction in close time.

data.title: INTERCOMPANY EFFICIENCY
data.quote: The intercompany reconciliation piece specifically — that had been taking us six to eight days manually. It now runs in under two hours

data.title: RISK MITIGATION
data.quote: every day you delay is a day you are flying blind. At our scale, with our complexity, the cost of not having a system like Prophix is not just efficiency — it is risk.
